en.html:
...I remembered.

She was one of the ladies who had served at Shirou Ashikaga's side.

Had she kept that rudeness in mind, found out my posting, and come to deliver a scolding in person?

If so, madam had a great deal of free time. Not spare time. Carefully employed time. First preserve the insult, then locate the offender, then bring the insult all the way here so that he may inspect it again. Such dedication. Had I known my manners would create this much work, I might have been more considerate.

Apparently my apology was now required to complete the delivery.
